resources.string: Calibrate on this device for your font, theme and display settings

Play music with Super Island active, then start a test and inspect the actual island above. First compare the original sample, then turn off “Show original sample” to check the fitted result. One unit is one CJK glyph. Saving applies this profile; closing or leaving this page restores live lyrics. Font, theme and island layout changes may require recalibration.

Leave equal-width options off unless the actual island confirms them. Estimated glyph widths may differ from a custom system font; adjust individual glyphs below when needed. Profiles are local to this device. Switching fonts or themes is not detected automatically.
